exposure: Low signal intensity bands on T2-weighted imaging
outcome: Maternal outcome after uterine artery embolization (UAE)-assisted cesarean section
cohort: 40 pregnant women who underwent UAE-assisted cesarean section due to suspected high risk of massive hemorrhage caused by invasive placenta previa
finding: The presence of low signal intensity bands on T2-weighted imaging was a significant predictor of poor maternal outcome (significant hemorrhage or emergency hysterectomy) after UAE-assisted cesarean section in patients with invasive placenta previa.
